description:
About Arrouya

Arrouya builds reservation and operations software for local governments. Their platform powers facility and park reservations, programs, permits, payments, and accounting.

They're a small engineering team working on a complex platform that supports the day-to-day operations of government organizations. As they continue to grow and modernize their product, they're looking for a Senior Product Engineer who cares deeply about building intuitive, high-quality user experiences.

The Role

They're looking for a product-minded full-stack engineer with a strong frontend focus and a great eye for design.

At Arrouya, UI/UX is a major driver of customer satisfaction. Their users are often non-technical, and making the platform intuitive, accessible, and easy to navigate is just as important as building new functionality.

You'll attend customer conversations to understand their needs, identify pain points, and translate feedback into thoughtful product improvements. You'll then take ownership of implementing those solutions, primarily on the frontend.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys moving between customer conversations, product decisions, and code.

What You'll Work On

  • Join customer calls with the co-founder to understand workflows, gather requirements, and identify opportunities to improve the product.

  • Translate customer feedback and business needs into intuitive UI/UX solutions.

  • Lead frontend development and improve the usability, consistency, and visual quality of the platform.

  • Build responsive, polished interfaces using React and Next.js.

  • Work across the stack when needed, contributing to backend functionality and integrations.

  • Help modernize and rebuild the existing platform using a modern technology stack.

  • Take ownership of features from understanding the problem through implementation and delivery.

  • Collaborate directly with the founders in a small, fast-moving engineering team.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Strong experience with React and Next.js.

  • Strong frontend development skills and a solid understanding of modern UI/UX principles.

  • A strong visual eye and the ability to recognize what makes an interface intuitive, polished, and easy to use.

  • Full-stack capabilities, with the ability to contribute to backend development when needed.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 level), with the ability to communicate confidently with US-based customers.

  • A proactive, customer-oriented mindset and the ability to listen carefully, ask the right questions, and take ownership of problems.

  • A portfolio or examples of websites and products you've built. We're interested in seeing the actual work you've shipped and understanding your contribution.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with the T3 stack or familiarity with its ecosystem.

  • Experience working directly with customers or translating business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Experience building SaaS products or complex web applications.

  • Interest in AI-powered development tools and workflows.

Why Join Arrouya?

  • Direct product impact: Your work will have a visible impact on how customers interact with and experience the platform.

  • Customer exposure: You'll work directly with customers, understand their challenges, and help shape the product around real-world needs.

  • High ownership: Join a small engineering team where you can influence technical and product decisions.

  • End-to-end involvement: Participate in the entire process, from identifying a customer problem to designing and shipping the solution.

Interview Process

  • Silver.dev Recruiter Screening

  • Silver.dev System Design Interview

  • Client Resume Review

  • Client Screening

  • Client System Design Interview
